# The world tour's stops: places to stand, with the input script to play there.
#
#   level|x|y|z|yaw|ctrlPitch|ctrlYaw|originX|originY|script|note
#
# Positions are relative to the level's own LevelTransform (originX/originY), because a level streams
# in at a different offset each load. Scripts are the ones in tools/worldtour/scripts.lua.
#
# This copy is the seed: tools\Install-UE4SS.ps1 -Probe only deploys it when the probe folder has no
# routes.txt, and never overwrites one, because the game writes to the deployed file. Stops are added
# in game with M (one spot, tools/routes.lua), H (every kind of character in this level,
# tools/scan.lua) or a scansweep.txt run (every level, tools/scansweep.lua). Copy them back here with
#
#   .\tools\Sync-Routes.ps1
#
# and commit, so a reinstall or a new machine starts with the route instead of rebuilding it.
